strategy.future_universe: active BTC linear future, quote=USDC, settlement=USDC

known_development_data.reason: Les contrats et primes figurant dans le diagnostic ont été vus pendant le développement; ils ne constituent ni holdout ni expérience non biaisée.

selection_policy.spot_identity: exactly one active BTC_USDC spot instrument with base BTC and quote USDC; ambiguity => WAIT
selection_policy.eligible_future: active BTC linear dated future with base BTC, quote USDC, settlement USDC and 14 <= (expiration_utc-now) days <= 90
selection_policy.order: earliest expiration_utc first; instrument_id ascending as deterministic tie-break; never maximize premium, PnL, mark or volume
selection_policy.quantity: largest common BTC quantity on both books, floored to the common amount step, satisfying all cash and margin constraints; fail if below both minimums
selection_policy.entry: walk spot asks and future bids at the same BTC quantity; use depth-weighted executable prices and reject inadequate depth
selection_policy.freshness: both books must be valid, uncrossed, positive-depth, received no more than 15 seconds before decision, market timestamps no more than 5 seconds apart, neither market timestamp may be in the future
selection_policy.entry_basis: future executable sell VWAP minus spot executable buy VWAP; non-positive => WAIT

exit_policy.normal: hold the linear future through its official expiry TWAP settlement; after the final settlement is received, liquidate the spot long by selling into the first valid observed spot bid book within 5 minutes of settlement period_end
exit_policy.spot_price: depth-walked bid VWAP from that spot book; never use future TWAP, index, mark, mid, or last trade as a spot fill
exit_policy.early_exit: no discretionary/economic early exit and no rollover. Protective exit only when derivative cash after applying short unrealized loss since the last official settlement (never credit unrealized short gains or spot gains) is below current initial margin plus the additional cash required for the frozen +25% adverse BTC stress at shocked-mark IM. Close future first through observed asks; then sell spot through observed bids. Preserve any partial/unbalanced state. Stale market data blocks new entry but does not trigger an automatic liquidation.
exit_policy.rollover: none; a new expiry requires a new independent entry decision and both legs/costs
exit_policy.missing_final_settlement: remain pending/uncertain; no inferred price or outcome

settlement_accounting.daily_settlement_time: 08:00 UTC; use the official period_end and official TWAP/index received from venue
settlement_accounting.short_daily_cash_pnl: q_btc * (previous_settlement_reference - current_official_index); first previous reference is the actual future entry fill price

cost_model.fee_currency_assumption: UNKNOWN_WORST_CASE: routed BTC_USDC spot fee debit asset is not established by public docs. Compare BASE and QUOTE for both spot entry and spot exit. BASE entry reduces BTC received; BASE exit consumes sold BTC plus BTC fee. QUOTE fees reduce cash. The decision budgets conservatively, publishes entry/exit residuals, and never labels PAPER fees as observed Deribit fees. The ledger's explicit BASE assumption remains a scenario only.

sources.used_claims: standard futures/perpetual taker 3.5 bps; routed spot taker 5 bps; USDC settled BTC/ETH futures delivery 2.5 bps
BTC_USDC spot routing and pair-level specifications must be verified; public pre-login visibility does not prove personal account eligibility

cost_model.execution_costs: entry price walks captured order-book depth and therefore already includes entry spread/depth; do not add a second entry slippage charge
cost_model.unknown_future_spot_exit: use entry-price notional only as a labeled fee estimate; no future spot fill or basis convergence is predicted
cost_model.delivery_fee_amount: proxy at entry future price until official expiry price is known; never treat as zero when amount is unknown
cost_model.stress: multiply configured commissions by 1.5 and observed executable spread/depth cost by 2; retain component attribution

margin_and_cash_model.mode_scenario: segregated_standard_margin_S_SM; venue default for new accounts, not user account qualification
margin_and_cash_model.source: https://support.deribit.com/hc/en-us/articles/25944811528477-Standard-Margin; BTC_USDC dated futures tier and Max Amount cross-checked against https://support.deribit.com/hc/en-us/articles/31424954805405-Linear-Futures on 2026-10-12
margin_and_cash_model.max_amount_policy: 885 BTC is the currently documented Standard Margin limit, not a guarantee; missing/stale metadata or a changed public limit blocks a trade until policy is reviewed/versioned
margin_and_cash_model.cash_separation: spot principal, derivative initial margin, adverse cash-loss buffer, commissions and operating cash are separately funded; spot unrealized gains cannot collateralize short-future losses
margin_and_cash_model.stress_cash: before admission, reserve sufficient cash for a +25% BTC index move plus required Tier-4 IM at the stressed mark, net only against already reserved entry IM; no credit for spot appreciation

decision_threshold.reserve_semantics: admission hurdle only; not a ledger debit and not margin cash
decision_threshold.net_before_reserve: entry premium less explicit entry/estimated exit fee and delivery fee proxies; known future spot exit basis is unobserved and not assumed to converge
decision_threshold.net_after_reserve: net_before_reserve minus the frozen 2% of allocated capital admission reserve; future empirical joint adverse residual requires a separately versioned policy and cannot be tuned into v1
decision_threshold.admission: WAIT until economic estimate after reserve is strictly positive and all market, quantity, cash, margin, and safety conditions pass
decision_threshold.evidence_note: The 2% floor is a conservative control witness, not a calibrated Deribit loss quantile. Until enough completed cycles support the joint residual estimate, status remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE even if a PAPER entry is mechanically admitted.

sample_and_evaluation.regime_definition: causal 30-calendar-day annualized realized volatility of Deribit BTC-USDC index at entry: low <30%, medium 30%-60% inclusive, high >60%; missing history => regime unknown and does not count
sample_and_evaluation.cycle_independence: one open cycle at a time; cycles cannot overlap; each entry-to-final-settlement-and-spot-liquidation outcome counts once
sample_and_evaluation.holdout: after code/policy freeze, first 10 fully matured non-overlapping eligible cycles, sealed before outcomes are accessed; development/diagnostic observations cannot be promoted
sample_and_evaluation.selection: no parameter search and no adaptive candidate expansion; this single frozen policy either passes all gates or remains unadopted
sample_and_evaluation.primary_metric: net realized USDC PnL after all observed/modelled fees divided by total allocated capital, with risk reserve shown as a separate hurdle
sample_and_evaluation.acceptance: lower 95% confidence bound of net return after the frozen reserve and all preregistered stresses > 0 in development and untouched forward holdout; max drawdown <=10% allocated capital; zero unhedged/accounting/margin/data violations
sample_and_evaluation.statistics: one-sided 95% bootstrap confidence bound over completed non-overlapping cycles; 10,000 resamples, seed 20261012; no bar-level pseudoreplication
sample_and_evaluation.insufficient_data: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; do not annualize a single cycle or declare a pass from fixtures

stress_tests: BTC index +25% before settlement; cash shortfall must be covered without spot gains
terminal spot/index basis residual adverse by 5% of allocated notional
USDC mark at 0.99 USD for USD-equivalent reporting; USDC-denominated ledger remains explicit
observed entry/exit book-walk execution cost multiplied by 2
zero/insufficient depth on either entry leg => reject; at exit use only observed depth and report residual inventory
daily/expiry settlement missing, delayed, duplicated, or corrected => pending/uncertain and no fabricated PnL
one leg rejected/partial and process restart before compensation => count unhedged exposure and risk response; do not count as a successful cycle

governance.experiment_spec: construct from this frozen policy and an actual immutable collector manifest; do not invent dataset hashes
governance.blind_forward_data: separate BLIND_FORWARD_OOS role only after protocol/code/candidate freeze
governance.search_gate: use ExperimentSpec, validate_search_ready, and GovernanceStore before any selection/economic evaluation
governance.replay_parity: fixtures qualify expiry-only settlement and protective-close mechanics; claim parity with the runner only after its implementation and triggers are independently reproduced
governance.technical_fixtures: may prove only deterministic mechanics, never market profitability
